application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T845 Sycamore:
Girdling root crossing over western buttress approx. 40mm dia. Some epicormic regrowth establishing on main stem 3 codominant leaders forming crown. 
*Carry out structural pruning with the selective removal of vertical regrowth establishing within crown
*Sever girdling root to the western quadrant
*Remove epicormic regrowth on main stem

T846 Common Horse Chestnut:
Growing on noticeable mound resulting from a suspected historical root plate failure now re-established. Mechanical damage to raised roots within lawn attributed to scalping by mower. Historically topped at 2.5m resulting in formation of 2 codominant leaders with adequate union formation. Epicormic regrowth establishing on lower stems.
 *Remove epicormic regrowth from main stem

T847 Sycamore: 
Historical wounding to western buttressing. Prominent buttress formation to east.  Sweep on main stem and asymmetrical crown bias to east due to competition from neighbouring trees. Epicormic regrowth establishing on upper stem. Vertical regrowth forming within crown.
*Remove epicormic regrowth
*Carry out structural pruning the selective removal of vertical regrowth forming within crown

T848 Common Lime:
Historical wounding to raised roots within lawn. Single stem specimen. Good resonance when sounded at base and on main stem. Bifurcation of main stem at 2.5m resulting in adequate union formation. Epicormic regrowth establishing on main stem.
*Crown lift to 3.0m height removing epicormic regrowth establishing on main stem. 

T850 Mountain Ash: 
Girdling root at base approx. 20mm diameter. 
*Sever girdling root.

T852 Common Lime:
Epicormic regrowth establishing on main stem. Bifurcation of main stem at 6.0m.
*Remove epicormic regrowth on main stem.

T853 Common Lime: 
Epicormic regrowth recently managed at base and establishing on upper main stem.
*Remove epicormic regrowth on the upper main stem.

T855 Common Lime:
In direct contact with public footpath causing a level of disturbance. Epicormic regrowth establishing from 2.0m on main stem.
*Crown lift to 3.0m removing epicormic regrowth and providing suitable clearance over path.

T856 Common Lime
In direct contact with public footpath causing a level of disturbance. Epicormic regrowth establishing from 2.0m on main stem.
*Crown lift to 3.0m removing epicormic regrowth and providing suitable clearance over path.

T857 Common Lime: 
In direct contact with public footpath causing a level of disturbance.  Epicormic regrowth establishing from 2.0m on main stem.
*Crown lift to 3.0m removing epicormic regrowth and providing suitable clearance over path.

T858 Pissards Plum
Lower northern crown overhanging access road previous pruning to provide clearance. Southern crown partially overhanging public footpath.
*Carry out a crown lift and selective pruning to provide adequate clearance over access road and adjacent public footpath.

All works are part of cyclical maintenance to ensure health, safety & amenity value of the trees
